text.en:
Marikina Heights Subdivision in Barangay Concepcion in the Municipality of Marikina,
Metro-Manila, is hereby detached and separated therefrom to form and constitute into a distinct and
independent barangay which is created to be known as Barangay Marikina Heights without affecting in any
manner the legal existence of the mother barangay Concepcion.

Except as hereinafter provided, all provisions of law, now or hereafter applicable to regular
barangays, shall be applicable to barangay Marikina Heights.

The present elective barangay officials of Barangay Concepcion shall continue to perform their
duties as such officials in the newly created Barangay Marikina Heights until the barangay officials of said
barangay shall have been appointed by the President. Such officials so appointed shall hold office until their
successors shall have been elected in the regular elections for barangay officials following the issuance of this
decree and shall qualified, unless sooner removed at the pleasure of the President. Such appointive officers
and employees as may be necessary to organize or to complete the government personnel of the Barangay
Marikina Heights shall be appointed as provided for under existing laws.

Upon the effectivity of this Decree, the proportionate share of Barangay Marikina Heights in the
obligations, funds, assets and other properties of Barangay Concepcion shall be transferred by the President to
the newly created barangay upon the recommendation of the Commission on Audit.

All laws or parts of laws as well as all executive orders or regulations, inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
